## 1.2.3

Catalog resync for four actors whose input contracts changed to stop confident-wrong answers and surprise bills found by testing minimal agent inputs. No tool renames.

- `hrsa-shortage-designation-monitor` (build 1.1.9): `state` now accepts a 2-letter USPS code (`"TX"`) as well as HRSA's full name, and an unrecognised value fails the run without billing. Before, `{"state":"TX"}` succeeded with 0 rows. MUA/MUP rows are now read from the HRSA Data Warehouse (the GeoPortal MUA layer lost its state/score/status columns), and every row carries `run_layers_requested`, `run_layers_failed`, `run_complete`, `state_input`.
- `hud-affordable-housing-explorer` (build 1.1.5): `states` is now REQUIRED (no default, `minItems: 1`). An omitted or unrecognised value used to search Colorado silently.
- `city-business-license-leads` (build 1.1.7): `maxResults` is now ONE cap for the whole run, split fairly across cities (it was per city, so an empty call emitted 4,001 rows). Rows carry `run_max_results` and `city_row_quota`.
- `sos-registry-monitor` (build 1.1.6): `mode` description now states that an omitted `mode` means a name search for "LLC", not openings; `states` title lists the 7 codes. Rows from search/new_businesses carry `formation_date_in_future` and `formation_date_days_ahead` (Colorado accepts delayed effective dates).
